headline: It turns out how expensive the summer heat was: import electricity price jumped brutally
summary: Electricity production, import prices and volumes showed how costly the August outage at the Paks nuclear plant was. The report links domestic generation to wider foreign economic implications.
why: Paks is Hungary's nuclear power plant, and its outages force the country to rely on costlier imports, affecting consumer and industrial power prices.
